verdict.rationale: vLLM documents loading standard Hugging Face model formats directly across 200+ architectures, a Transformers modeling backend, and GGUF/GPTQ/AWQ quantized formats. This implies widely shared model files can be used without vendor-specific conversion. However, nothing documents where downloads are cached, whether that cache is shared with other runtimes, or whether re-downloading is avoided. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of download/cache location and sharing (e.g., reuse of the HF cache), statements about cross-runtime reuse without re-download, and any hands-on corroboration.
